settings.learner: standardized ridge least squares, uncalibrated risk score
settings.graph: static 4-neighbour path cost dx*(1+abs(elevation_difference)/0.05m); walls/solids block paths; max path 50m
settings.wrong_graph: directed double-edge swaps preserving in/out degree and per-target distance rings within common raw pool
settings.ranking: ceil(fraction*n); ties resolved by ascending flattened cell index
settings.budget: six new processes, 18 frozen replays, five fits, one fixed hyperparameter setting; no tuning on holdout

limits: three held-out synthetic development events; linear screening, not full nonlinear strong-baseline confirmation; no final test
